comparison.silhouette_quality_review: NEGATIVE. Both candidate and baseline are still plain printed Kaiti characters; vertical arrangement alone does NOT produce source-like unified brush wordmark. Horizontal 山海 even reads more naturally at first glance, and vertical 风云 is not obviously impossible. The 3-vs-10 stroke ratio does not independently dictate aesthetic layout.

next_true_bottleneck: Need a method to invent and assess coherent cross-character brush gesture and topology, not a rectangle rearranger. Do not repeat a fourth font-only layout variant; only one actual artist-documented path-stage case justifies further transfer attempt.
cost: No newly paid AI API, license or design software; existing Python and local fonts only.
